# netbox_rear_ports (Data Source)

Lists NetBox rear port objects (`/api/dcim/rear-ports/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_rear_ports" "all" {}

data "netbox_rear_ports" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "q", value = "example" },
  ]
  limit = 10
}

output "rear_ports_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_rear_ports.filtered.items[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/dcim/rear-ports/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `cable_end` (String) Cable End.
- `cable_id` (Number) Cable. References `netbox_cable`.
- `color` (String) Color. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `device_id` (Number) ID of the Device (`netbox_device`).
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `front_ports` (Attributes List) Front Ports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--front_ports))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `label` (String) Physical label. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `link_peers_type` (String) Return the type of the peer link terminations, or None.
- `mark_connected` (Boolean) Treat as if a cable is connected. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `module_id` (Number) ID of the Module (`netbox_module`).
- `name` (String) Name.
- `occupied` (Boolean) Occupied.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `positions` (Number) Positions. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `type` (String) Type. One of 63 valid NetBox choices (see the NetBox documentation).
- `url` (String) Url.

### Nested Schema for `items.front_ports`

Read-Only:
